childReport.manualNotes: The most subtle logic for re-implementation: gap thresholds use min_gap_us = min-gap-ms*1000.0; prev_event is the max-end event in the prior merged interval, next_event is the min-start event in the next; CPU containers overlap the gap arithmetic midpoint and are kept as the 8 shortest by duration; gap ranking is by duration descending (reverse=True) then truncated to topn. Output units: ts/dur in microseconds, printed in ms (dur/1000); name truncation limits are 160 for prev/next and 180 for containers.
